meta.title: Souqna
meta.description: Buy and sell safely. Your money is held until you receive your item.

home.promiseTitle: Your money is safe until you receive your item
home.promiseBody: You pay us and we hold the money. The seller only gets it once the item reaches you and it's what you agreed.
home.step1: Pick an item and chat with the seller in the app.
home.step2: Pay, and we hold your money safely.
home.step3: Receive and check the item, then the money goes to the seller.

login.title: Log in
login.intro: Log in with your mobile number. No email needed.
login.phoneHint: Example: 0912345678. Your number is never shown to anyone.
login.resendIn: You can request a new code in {seconds} seconds

onboarding.title: Complete your profile
onboarding.intro: Your name and city are shown to people on your listings.
onboarding.displayNameHint: Don't include a phone number or link.
